blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The president of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) has called on the House to explain the nearly 7,000 infrastructure projects worth P190 billion that were added to the proposed 2027 national budget without publicly available supporting documents. In a statement on Monday, Oct. 26, CBCP president Bishop Pablo Virgilio David cited the preliminary findings of the People’s Budget Coalition (PBC), presented by its co-convenor Ken Abante before the Senate, on the House-approved version of the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget. Questionable allocations The findings raised concerns about the possible recurrence of questionable spending practices following the […]...
